ability.name: Sacred Tome
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **^^Priest^^**, it has **^^Priest (1)^^**. If this unit is already a **^^Priest^^**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit. If this unit is a Wizard, it cannot use **^^Spell^^** abilities and **^^Prayer^^** abilities in the same phase.

ability.name: Glimmering
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 save roll for this unit.

ability.name: Brazier of Holy Flame
ability.effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to that unit.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Cities of Sigmar Infantry^^** unit that is not in combat and wholly within 12" of this unit.
